## Description and Rationale

Solo participant from Brazil. I am an independent developer learning
data science and machine learning with Python, focusing on real-world
prediction problems and competitions.

I registered for the PRC Data Challenge 2026 because taxi-out time
prediction is a well-defined tabular problem built on real, open
aviation data, and it is a great opportunity to practice feature
engineering, gradient boosting models and time-based validation.
I also value the open-science approach of the challenge: I plan to
publish my code on GitHub under GPLv3 and share what I learn with
the community.
